about-me.text: My name is Albin Kärvling. I’m a frontend developer and project lead at ATG, working across frontend architecture, Node.js GraphQL BFFs and cloud infrastructure. I started programming at 12 and enjoy turning complex systems into accessible, reliable user experiences.

cards.title: Frontend Developer & Project Lead
cards.subTitle: Swedish horse racing and gaming company
description: Leading frontend development for an internal customer-service platform spanning multiple teams.
Responsible for its React and TypeScript frontend and Node.js GraphQL BFF architecture.
Building business-critical functionality across payments, responsible gambling, AML and customer accounts.

cards.title: Rythm - Frontend
cards.subTitle: Discord music bot
description: Contributed features to the dashboard of Discord’s largest bot
Worked with backend developers and designers to turn ideas and designs into working features.

cards.title: Self-taught developer
cards.subTitle: Personal development
description: Started programming at 12, initially focusing on frontend development.
Eventually wandered into backend development, cloud infrastructure and architecture.
Still building things whenever an idea seems interesting enough.
